title: 同类目订单去重汇总
query: 只查询 ecommerce_ops：对2026年8月1日至22日下单且实付金额大于0的订单，按商品类目名称统计订单级实付金额合计；同一个订单在同一个类目只计算一次，取金额最高的5类。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: WITH order_category AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id, o.paid_amount, pc.category_name FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN products p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id JOIN product_categories pc ON p.category_id = pc.category_id WHERE o.ordered_at >= TIMESTAMP '2026-08-01 00:00:00' AND o.ordered_at < TIMESTAMP '2026-08-23 00:00:00' AND o.paid_amount > 0) SELECT category_name AS "商品类目名称", SUM(paid_amount) AS "订单实付金额合计" FROM order_category GROUP BY category_name ORDER BY SUM(paid_amount) DESC LIMIT 5
